entries.title: Fixed Rising Vault and Rear Flue Cutaway Kiln
entries.description: One independently authored complete empty rising-vault kiln illustrative cutaway. A common broad finite masonry foundation carries a low front open fire chamber, a raised throat step and an entire ascending internal floor beneath a long continuous thick arched shell. The front-facing middle side of that shell is deliberately removed with thick finished cut edges to expose the uninterrupted rising chamber; complete end arch collars remain integral to the shell. A complete rear arched wall has a genuine low throat opening leading into a tall rear hollow rectangular flue with a side inlet and open top. The fire chamber and rising chamber have different floor heights and meet at a real open passage, not an old horizontal bread oven extended or an old rectangular shelf kiln resized. Whole connected shells and an integral raised floor step, no old geometry imported. Four opaque matte stone/refractory roles, metres Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. One whole architectural display prop zero scenes. Empty static artistic section only: no fire, fuel, ware, firing cycle, temperature, ventilation, chimney draft, emissions, thermal design, construction, installation, historical accuracy, load or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Crossed Leg and Open V Log Cradle
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed empty sawbuck-style log cradle. Two separated end stations each have two whole long crossing timber legs; the same four members continue well above their transverse pins to form two genuinely open V-shaped upper cradles. Two continuous low longitudinal ties join the end stations below the crossing levels, while independent short lower stop straps hold the fixed spread. Four complete grounded pads and whole side pivot caps finish the unified stand. There is deliberately no top beam, tabletop, work plank, split vise jaw or lead-screw mechanism. Unlike the old four splayed legs converging below a flat sawhorse beam, the upper load-outline is an open V at both ends and the long space between them stays empty; unlike the folding split-jaw bench its crossed legs continue into the cradle rather than ending under a flat clamp bed. Entire numeric geometry newly authored, no old legs extracted or extended. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and whole ground-centred origin, one whole prop zero scenes. Empty static art only: no timber, saw, chain, folding movement, spread adjustment, log fit, sawing, work holding, load, strength, manufacture, stability or equipment safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Open Scales and Round Nose Grooming Razor
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed-open folding grooming-razor-style exterior with intentionally blunt geometry. Two entire slightly curved thick handle scales enclose a genuine long empty gap, joined at the rear by a full spacer and at the front by one whole transverse pin with two separate retaining caps. One continuous broad round-nosed plate narrows into an integral short tang and curled rear finger-tail silhouette; it lies in the handle-layer gap at the pivot and extends outward at one fixed angle. All edges remain finite thickness with no sharpened edge or cutting geometry. Unlike the old axial T-head razor there is no transverse arched cap/guard pair; unlike the old utility cutter there is no sleeve, sliding thumb button or lengthwise extension. All geometry newly authored, no old blade or handle extracted. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and full bounds-centred low ground datum, one complete model zero scenes. Fixed illustrative salon prop only: no skin, person, blade insertion/removal, shaving, cutting, fold travel, bearing fit, operating procedure, ergonomic suitability, hygiene, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Open Case Notched Disc and Blank Dial Display
entries.description: One whole newly authored combination-lock-inspired static exhibition exterior, not a functioning lock. A continuous thick open-front case has an actual side bolt port and two complete broad grounded feet. A real bored rear collar and full transverse fixed axis join three separate whole thick annular discs with genuine differently oriented perimeter indentations, and a stepped blank exterior dial. A separate upper rear-supported pin carries one entire bent lever and transverse bar deliberately clear above the discs. A whole blunt horizontal bolt lies in a separate complete bored low guide and exits the side port, without an operating connection to the upper lever. This is not the old door lever lock with its spindle cam and two side tongues, nor a U-shackle padlock enlarged or decorated: the entire coaxial disc inspection group and separate upper spanning lever are new whole organisation. All visible coordinates newly authored; no old model imported. Four opaque PBR roles. One static prop zero scenes, metres Z up and complete horizontal bounds centred. Blank fixed art only: no valid combination, matching gates, functional security mechanism, tolerances, movement, access control, installation, locking resistance, manipulation, unlocking, manufactured fit or safety performance. No operating instructions. Rigging animation interaction not made or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Three Runner Open Cockpit and Mast Sail Iceboat
entries.description: One wholly newly authored empty ice-sailing-craft-inspired static exterior. A long forward spine intersects one broad transverse rear runner plank, with two independent short blunt blades far outboard and a third blade at the far forward end. Three complete carriers form a spread three-point ground layout. A narrow whole chamfer-ended single cockpit has thick walls and a genuine open interior floor, one low seat and rear-leaning pad. One tall leaning mast, complete long lower boom and continuous thick bowed sail rise from a floor-rooted pedestal; three whole fixed stays connect the upper mast to the wide underframe. This is not the old tandem bobsled shortened or a snowmobile with its track removed: its entire long-spine / wide-plank / outboard-blade support organisation is newly authored. It is not the side-float canoe with an extra float or a windsurf board with runners; there is no boat pontoon, standing board, footstrap or wishbone. No old mesh imported, all visible coordinates new. Four opaque constant PBR roles, one prop zero scenes, metres Z up and complete horizontal-envelope-centred origin at three finite blade soles. Empty fixed art only; no real ice compatibility, sliding, steering, stability, load, occupant fit, aerodynamic or structural capability, tension, propulsion, rig movement, sporting standard, manufacture or safety declaration. No rigging animation or interaction made or verified.
